description_en: If an O\\\&M engineer attempts to run a command specified in the Command Approval section of the Create Control Policy page, the administrator is notified to review the command in the Bastionhost console. The command can be run only after it is approved by the administrator
description_zh: 如果运维员执行了配置在命令审批控制策略中的命令，管理员会在堡垒机控制台收到该命令的审批，只有管理员审批允许后该命令才能正常执行，审批拒绝后该命令不可执行
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost reject-approve-command --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --command-id 574 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RejectApproveCommand
